description: Changes the start time and/or title of a watch party (a room made with create_watch_room, same room_code). The link stays the same, so invitations already sent keep working — prefer this over cancelling and creating a new one. Needs the organiser_key (or organiser_link) from create_watch_room. Guests who already added the old time to their calendar should be told to update it.

room_code.description: The 5-character room code. Not needed when organiser_link is given.

start_time.description: New start: ISO 8601 date-time WITH a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-08T21:00:00+08:00. Up to 60 days ahead.

name: update_watch_party

code.description: Error code when ok is false.

ok.description: false when the call failed; then code says why.

title: Change a watch party
